br_head_chronology: The report retains 7b2e283 as its review-intake head; source-freeze and receipt records use the later 43d594a author checkpoint, independently verified here. The target was initially a frozen untracked author proposal.

whitespace_check.disposition: Preserve the one final blank line in the immutable pre-packet mathematical findings; no whitespace cleanup rewrites frozen evidence and no clean full-set check is claimed.

concurrent_scope: Updated MANUSCRIPT_RG lines 1-120 read only. Its three diagnostic script/log pairs were not executed or used as mathematical evidence. Cycle2 first-step SU(2) rough-core/cap claims remain unchecked; U1-U4 and full histories remain open.
cache_limit: Local HTML/PDF hashes verify retrieval bytes only; rendered read windows are not raw byte lines, and no cache is published as a repository dependency.
